title: Towards Fair Machine Learning Software: Understanding and Addressing Model Bias Through Counterfactual Thinking
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical algorithmic fairness and bias mitigation in machine learning software using statistical metrics such as Statistical Parity Difference and Average Odds Difference. It evaluates these using tabular datasets (e.g., census, credit, and criminal justice data) rather than benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
